retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical urban portrait featuring two figures with backs turned, framed by a large translucent 'X' overlay and diagonal, mirrored typography.
excludeWhen: a minimalist white background is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, symmetrical composition of two figures in oversized streetwear standing back-to-back, overlaid with a large, semi-transparent 'X' that dictates the flow of diagonal, mirrored sans-serif typography against a warm sunset sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two central figures
Diagonal alignment of text following the 'X' overlay
Contrast between warm sky and cool-toned denim
Vertical mirroring of top and bottom text elements
coreInvariants: Large translucent 'X' shape spanning the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures centered, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the 'X' overlay between the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal lines of the 'X' from the corners toward the center, then vertically between the mirrored text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sunset sky in the upper half provides breathing room for the display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm peach and orange sunset tones in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and blacks of the jerseys and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Acid green or bright yellow for the lower diagonal text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark silhouettes of the subjects and the bright, saturated sky.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rotated 45 degrees to align with diagonal axes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with color and orientation variations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, urban weight and clean terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity for diagonal rotation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical photo of two people in 90s streetwear standing back-to-back in a field at sunset, with a large semi-transparent 'X' shape overlaid across the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold geometric sans-serif text in uppercase along the four arms of the 'X', ensuring the bottom text is mirrored vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the 'X' overlay visible and centered?
Is the text aligned exactly to the 45-degree diagonals?
Is the bottom text mirrored/upside down?
Are the subjects wearing their clothes backwards?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Ensure the 'X' is a graphic element, not a literal object in the scene
postGenerationChecks: Verify diagonal alignment with the X-overlay
Ensure subjects are centered and symmetrical
Confirm color contrast between text and background
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Duo + Diagonal X-Overlay + Mirrored Geometric Typography
